description: Charleston, SC - State Representative Leon Stavrinakis (D-119) announced on Thursday his intention to run for re-election in 2018. Stavrinakis, a lifelong Charlestonian, is a member of the budget-writing Ways and Means Committee as well as the House Ethics Committee. He was first elected to the House in 2006.
